instruction: Use Immersive Reader to focus on the sunscreen ingredient news. A child in the family was born on January 15, 2026. Based on the article's age guidance for the newly approved sunscreen ingredient, determine the first date the child is old enough for that ingredient. In Thunderbird Calendar, create an all-day event on that date. Set the title to `Sunscreen ingredient reminder`.
gt_steps: Start from the already-open AP News article about the FDA approving a new sunscreen ingredient in Microsoft Edge.
Use Immersive Reader to simplify the article.
Find the age guidance for the newly approved sunscreen ingredient.
Use the guidance that the ingredient is safe for adults and children 6 months and older.
Because the child was born on January 15, 2026, calculate the first date they are 6 months old as July 15, 2026.
In the Calendars list, enable the Home calendar if it is disabled.
Create an all-day calendar event for July 15, 2026.
Set the title to `Sunscreen ingredient reminder`.
